source.author: verg
source.text: Ipse tibi ad tua templa feram sollemnia dona et statuam ante aras aurata fronte iuvencum candentem pariterque caput cum matre ferentem, iam cornu petat et pedibus qui spargat harenam.
source.text_original: Ipse tibi ad tua templa feram sollemnia dona / et statuam ante aras aurata fronte iuvencum / candentem pariterque caput cum matre ferentem, / iam cornu petat et pedibus qui spargat harenam.'
source.text_english: I myself will bring to your shrine the customary offerings and will set before the altars a gleaming bullock with gilded brow, one already beginning to thrust with its horn and to scatter the sand with its feet, and its head along with its mother’s.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: vestris egomet tune vellera templis illa dabo, dabit auratis et cornibus igni colla pater, niveique greges altaria cingent.
reuse.text_original: vestris egomet tune vellera templis / illa dabo, dabit auratis et cornibus igni / colla pater, niveique greges altaria cingent.
reuse.text_english: Shall I myself then give those fleeces to your temples? Their father shall give his neck to the gilded fire, and snowy flocks shall surround the altars.
